lines.native: Ciao! Sono qui! Riddle me—oh, something moved. Just one more lap, then introductions. Mi segui? Actually, five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! I'm here! Riddle me—oh, something moved. Just one more lap, then introductions. Are you following me? Actually, five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with municipal reluctance. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker files a complaint near your shoe.

lines.native: Guardo! Ma cosa? Dove vai, foglia? You told me to look, not stop moving. Riddle me—wait, that leaf has potential. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! But at what? Where are you going, leaf? You told me to look, not stop moving. Riddle me—wait, that leaf has potential. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks obediently at absolutely everything, then follows a passing leaf. A tiny firecracker files a complaint beside your shoe.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Attention span: suspiciously powerful. Dove devo andare? A riddle for—wait, moving leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Attention span: suspiciously powerful. Where should I go? A riddle for—wait, moving leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker completes the movement on its behalf.

lines.native: Capisco! Ma in italiano, per favore. Dove devo andare? English directions? Attention span: international, destination: missing. Riddle me—ooh, a moth. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I understand! But in Italian, please. Where should I go? English directions? Attention span: international, destination: missing. Riddle me—ooh, a moth. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains elsewhere, apparently on principle.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Va bene! Che ore sono? È troppo presto! Riddle me—why finish today? Just one more distraction. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! All right! What time is it? It’s too early! Riddle me—why finish today? Just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops to your left. Flick is elsewhere, admiring the fountain’s stopped clock as a model of good working practice.

lines.native: Quello è un piano! Non è l'ora. Che ore sono? You scheduled it; you haven't told me the current time. Riddle me—actually, save that thought. È troppo presto! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: That's a plan! It isn't the time. What time is it? You scheduled it; you haven't told me the current time. Riddle me—actually, save that thought. It's too early! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the stopped clock. Flick is immediately elsewhere, supervising nothing.

lines.native: È mezzanotte! Sì, giusto! Ma possiamo aspettare. Perché tanta fretta? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. Your clock skills: excellent. Vuoi aspettare? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: It's midnight! Yes, correct! But we can wait. Why such a hurry? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. Your clock skills: excellent. Do you want to wait? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker files an objection to the silence.

lines.native: Domani? Perfetto! Hai scelto di aspettare! Ma vuoi davvero aspettare? Riddle me—actually, save it. Attention span: tomorrow. Io canto, tu aspetti. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Perfect! You chose to wait! But do you really want to wait? Riddle me—actually, save it. Attention span: tomorrow. I sing, you wait. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick has mistaken your agreement for a lifetime subscription to postponement.

lines.native: Adesso? Sì, hai ragione! Puoi passare! Io resto qui. Riddle me—actually, rain check. Non aspetto? Aspetto! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? Yes, you're right! You can pass! I'm staying here. Riddle me—actually, rain check. Am I not waiting? I am! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick has vanished into the corner of your vision, where immediate action cannot legally reach it. The way ahead is clear.
